label: Open-Meteo
description: Weather and forecasts, no key needed
agentGuide: No key. Coordinates first: GET https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?name=Lyon&count=1&language=fr gives latitude/longitude. Then GET /v1/forecast?latitude=45.76&longitude=4.83&current=temperature_2m,weather_code,wind_speed_10m&daily=temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum&timezone=auto (add &forecast_days=7, &hourly=... as needed). History: https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?...&start_date=&end_date=. Air quality: https://air-quality-api.open-meteo.com/v1/air-quality?...&current=european_aqi. weather_code follows WMO codes (0 clear, 61 rain, 95 storm). Values are metric by default; be fair with the free service (no bursts of calls).
